FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Before writing to us, take a look at the answers to the most common questions.
FAQ.PAGE_SUBTITLE: Savings, loans, digital services and practical steps: find useful answers before contacting a branch.
FAQ.Q1: What types of accounts does FINSTAR-CM S.A. offer?
FAQ.A1: Savings account, current account, blocked account, daily savings (doorstep collection), term deposit and fixed-term account. Opening is free for individuals; it costs 2,500 FCFA for Business and Association accounts. In every case an initial deposit is required, and that money remains yours. Full details are on the Services & Products page.
FAQ.Q2: How do I get a loan?
FAQ.A2: You must hold a FINSTAR-CM S.A. account, actively use it for at least 3 months, prepare a complete file, write a handwritten request addressed to the Managing Director, provide a personal contribution and propose collateral. Every application remains subject to review.
FAQ.Q3: Which documents are required for a loan application?
FAQ.A3: The complete list depends on the credit type. It includes a handwritten request addressed to the Managing Director, valid identification, location maps, the NUI, bank statements for the last 3 months, passport photos, evidence of the need, collateral, the personal contribution and guarantors’ documents. The Services page provides the complete checklist for each type.
FAQ.Q4: Which types of loan are available?
FAQ.A4: Classic loans, personal or salaried loans, and investment loans.
FAQ.A5: A service that lets you save every day effortlessly: a FINSTAR-CM S.A. collection officer visits your place of business to pick up your deposits, confirmed at each visit. It matches the daily savings account presented on the Services & Products page.
FAQ.A6: FINSTAR-CM S.A. has six branches: Yaoundé – Nkolbisson, Yaoundé – Essos, Yaoundé – Etoudi, Douala – Bessengue, Bafoussam and Bangangté. The head office is in Yaoundé – Bastos and the registered office in Bayangam. All addresses are listed on the Our branches page.
FAQ.Q7: Is FINSTAR-CM S.A. a licensed institution?
FAQ.A7: Yes. FINANCIAL STAR CAMEROON S.A. (FINSTAR-CM S.A.) is a public limited company registered under number RC/BJN/2023/B/03 and a licensed second-tier microfinance institution under licence N° 0000499. Registered office in Bayangam, head office in Yaoundé – Bastos. The first branch opened on 26 November 2024 in Yaoundé – Nkolbisson.
FAQ.A8: By email (contact@finstar-cm.com), by phone or WhatsApp (+237 620 724 796), or through the contact form.
FAQ.Q9: Is there a fee to open an account with FINSTAR-CM S.A.?
FAQ.A9: Opening is free for personal accounts; it costs 2,500 FCFA for Business and Association accounts. An initial deposit is required depending on the account — 5,000 FCFA for a personal current account, 10,000 FCFA for a personal savings account, 15,000 FCFA for a Business or Association account — and that money remains yours. Come to a branch with valid ID and 4 passport photos (4×4), or 2 for the daily collection account.
FAQ.Q10: Which digital services does FINSTAR-CM S.A. offer?
FAQ.A10: FINSTAR-CM S.A. offers FINSAVE to top up an account remotely and FINALERT for SMS notifications on transactions. Daily savings are collected in person at your place of business.
FAQ.Q11: Which Mobile Money and transfer services are available?
FAQ.A11: Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, SARA Money, SmobilPay, Western Union, MoneyGram and RIA, plus Afriland and Ecobank deposits. FINSTAR-CM S.A. also handles bill payment (SOCADEL, ENEO, CANAL+, taxes and duties), tuition payment and salary payment.
FAQ.A12: Fees and rates depend on the product and the transaction. At opening: 5,000 FCFA initial deposit for a personal current account, 10,000 FCFA for a personal savings account, 15,000 FCFA for a Business or Association account with a 2,500 FCFA opening fee. Other conditions are set out in the pricing schedule and contract applicable when you apply.
FAQ.Q13: How can I file a complaint or report a problem?
FAQ.A13: Email contact@finstar-cm.com, call +237 620 724 796 or use the contact form and describe your request precisely.
